Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Yes, damaged items are handled differently from a normal return.
When an item arrives damaged, you should contact our support team within 3 days of delivery. If the damage is caused by Avocado's manufacturing or logistics teams, you can qualify for a replacement instead of needing to go through the standard return process.
For damaged items, you'll need to provide photos and a description of the defect to our support team. They'll review your documentation and guide you through the next steps — which may include a repair, replacement, or return depending on the situation. Processing time for replacement requests can take up to 7 business days, not including any production time needed to make the replacement item.

Do you need photos, and where do I send them?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Yes, photos are required for damaged items. Here's what you need to document:
Photos to take:
The damaged packaging itself (especially if it shows potential product damage)
Clear photos of the entire product
Close-ups of the affected areas (punctures, indentations, etc.)
A common object placed near the damaged area to show scale
Photos of the law tag showing the barcode (both front and back if available)
Where to send them:
Email the photos and description of the defect to support@avocadomattress.com. Include your order number, email, and current shipping address for faster processing.
Alternatively, if you're chatting with the support team, you can attach the photos directly in the chat.
You should receive a confirmation email within 12-72 hours after reporting the damage. If you don't hear back, reach out to the support team for assistance.
